comment: The raw conformance driver (programs/raw). "expectations" is read by GenConfigs.java like every expectations file; the raw driver is no matrix language, so it holds nothing. "conformance" holds the expected failures of the conf-java-* scenarios, which programs/raw/gen_conf.py generates (see its header for the fields).

conformance.see: spec:jsonrpc.org/specification §4 (method MUST be a String; -32600 Invalid Request)
conformance.reason: A request whose method is the number 42 is read as a request for method "42" and answered -32601; JSON-RPC 2.0 makes it an invalid request, -32600 (Java: being fixed in a parallel SDK branch).

conformance.see: spec:jsonrpc.org/specification §4 (id MUST be a String, Number or Null; -32600 with id null)
conformance.reason: A request with an object id is executed and its result echoes the object id; JSON-RPC 2.0 allows only a string, number or null id, so -32600 with id null is expected (Java: being fixed in a parallel SDK branch).
A request with "jsonrpc": "1.0" is executed; JSON-RPC 2.0 says jsonrpc MUST be exactly "2.0", so -32600 is expected (Java: being fixed in a parallel SDK branch).
session/new with cwd 42 succeeds: Jackson coerces the number to a string and nothing checks the schema type; -32602 is expected (Java: being fixed in a parallel SDK branch).

params that cannot be read as the request type (an array for session/new) fail inside the handler and are answered -32603 with the Jackson message; -32602 is expected (Java: being fixed in a parallel SDK branch).
session/new without the required cwd succeeds: required params are not checked; -32602 is expected (Java: being fixed in a parallel SDK branch).
session/prompt whose prompt is a string, not an array, is answered -32603 with the Jackson message; -32602 is expected (Java: being fixed in a parallel SDK branch).

RFD gap B: the RFD answers an unknown Acp-Session-Id with 404 (:268, :301) but its reconnect flow opens the session stream before session/load (:237-244); the Java server keeps it open as a provisional stream.

conformance.see: spec:jsonrpc.org/specification §4 (method MUST be a String; -32600 Invalid Request)
conformance.reason: The Java client answers a request whose method is the number 42 with -32601; -32600 is expected (as on the agent side) (Java: being fixed in a parallel SDK branch).

conformance.see: spec:jsonrpc.org/specification §4 (id MUST be a String, Number or Null; -32600 with id null)
conformance.reason: The Java client executes a permission request with an object id and echoes it; -32600 with id null is expected (Java: being fixed in a parallel SDK branch).
The Java client executes a permission request with "jsonrpc": "1.0"; -32600 is expected (Java: being fixed in a parallel SDK branch).
A permission request whose options is a string fails in the client's handler and is answered -32603 with the Jackson message; -32602 is expected (Java: being fixed in a parallel SDK branch).
